list.sortMostReadHint: „Most read“ arrives once Plausible counts on branding.supply — until then there would be no number, only an order.
list.emptyDescription: Try another combination of format, topic and language.

article.updatedNote: Updated whenever numbers or facts change.
article.translationMissing: This language has not been edited yet — you are reading the base version.

sources.title: Sources
sources.lead: Every statement carries its publisher and date. Quotes are capped at {max} characters.
sources.empty: No source is on file for this piece.

public.listLead: Brand profiles, duels, articles and rankings — linked, not blogged.
public.notFoundBody: The address leads nowhere. It may have been renamed or withdrawn — the journal shows what is here today.
public.topicLead: Everything on {topic}: brand profiles, duels, articles and rankings.
public.brandLead: Marks, history and assessment of {brand} — every statement with its source.
public.rankingsLead: Frozen editions with a visible as-of date. A refresh is a new edition.

correction.title: Something is wrong here
correction.lead: We correct what is wrong — and remove on request, without discussion.
correction.fieldHint: For example: founding year, industry, claim.
correction.reasonHint: Optional — but a source helps us decide faster.
correction.reasonRemovalHint: Required: a removal request without a reason cannot be processed.
correction.emailHint: Optional. We only use it to ask back — no newsletters.
correction.thanks: Received. We will look into it and get back to you if you left an address.

errors.alreadyOpen: You already have something open on this page. We are on it.
errors.rateLimited: Too many submissions in a short time. Please try again later.
errors.unavailable: That did not work just now. Please try again later.
errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again later.

newsletter.title: New piece, one email
newsletter.lead: Brand profiles, duels, articles and rankings — we write when a new piece is out.
newsletter.promise: We write when a new piece is out. You will get a confirmation email first, and every email carries the unsubscribe link.
newsletter.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
newsletter.doneText: We sent you an email. One click on the link inside and you are on the list — the link is valid for 24 hours.

errors.rateLimited: That was a few attempts in a row. Please try again later.
errors.unavailable: Not possible right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.generic: Not possible right now. Please try again later.

confirm.title: Confirm your newsletter
confirm.confirmedText: Thank you. We write when a new piece is out, and every email carries the unsubscribe link.
confirm.alreadyText: This address was confirmed before. There is nothing left to do.
confirm.expiredText: The link was valid for 24 hours. Just sign up again and a fresh one is on its way.
confirm.invalidText: This link leads nowhere — it may have been used already. Sign up again and a fresh one is on its way.
confirm.unavailableText: We could not check the link. Your link is not broken — please try again in a few minutes.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.doneText: We will not write to you again. Your address is deleted after twelve months — until then the entry stays as proof that the unsubscribe worked.
unsubscribe.missingText: This link carries no valid identifier. You will find the right one at the end of every email we sent you.
unsubscribe.unavailableText: The unsubscribe did NOT go through. Please try again in a few minutes, or simply reply to one of our emails.

send.hint: Subject and body come from this piece — title, standfirst, address. Everyone gets their own language version and their own unsubscribe link.
send.recipients: Nobody on the list | Goes to one person | Goes to {count} people
send.introHint: Two or three sentences above the standfirst. Nothing more is needed — the piece itself is one click away.
send.confirmText: Nobody is on the list. | This email goes to one person. Emails cannot be taken back. | This email goes to {count} people. Emails cannot be taken back.
send.failedNote: {count} addresses could not be reached. They stay on the list and will get the next piece.
send.stoppedText: There is no mail route right now. Once the server has one again, the button continues exactly here — nobody gets anything twice.
send.emptyText: As soon as somebody has signed up and confirmed, the button appears here.
send.notPublicText: A draft has no address out there. The button appears once the piece is published.
send.noAddressText: This piece is published but has no page out there — its format is gated or the brand row is missing. An email would point nowhere.

profile.methodologyNote: One number per brand — the same one the brand check uses, with the method in the open.
profile.correctionNote: We review every suggestion and answer with a reason. Removal on request is granted without discussion.
profile.removedNote: This brand asked to be removed. We keep the date and the reason on file.
profile.noSecondScore: For a brand we do not own there is only the website score — a foundation maturity is never invented.

ranking.frozen: Frozen. A refresh appears as a new issue — this one stays.
ranking.removedNote: The place stays empty; the list is not renumbered.
ranking.ctaTitle: Should your brand be on this list?

radar.title: Topic radar
radar.lead: What runs on a curated set of channels — a signal for the desk, never content to rewrite.
radar.retention: API numbers live at most {days} days, or they are fetched again every day.
radar.noComments: No comment texts, no user names. The comment count is a public metric of the video.
radar.maxAge: Videos older than {days} days are not stored by the run — the radar shows what is running now.
radar.formula: Normalised to 100: the average of the signals we have (0–20 each), computed from {count} of {total} signals. Three of them work today: performance (views ÷ subscribers), age (half-life 90 days) and relevance (closeness to our topics). Search demand and competition are missing as long as there is no data source for them.
radar.empty: No run yet. The radar fetches its numbers once a day — or at the press of a button.
radar.emptyFiltered: No video matches this filter. Clear it to see everything again.
radar.missingText: Without a key the radar fetches nothing. The server environment needs the line NUXT_INSIGHTS_YOUTUBE_KEY. Only the public figures of the API are then stored per video, for at most {days} days — no comment texts, no user names.
radar.runDone: Done: {channels} channels, {videos} videos, {upserted} stored, {deleted} removed, {tooOld} too old.
radar.runErrors: one error on the way | one error on the way | {count} errors on the way
radar.rateLimited: Too many runs this hour. Try again shortly.
radar.notConfigured: Without an API key the radar cannot fetch anything.

skipped.not_configured: No API key present — the run fetched nothing.
skipped.no_channels: No channels configured — the run fetched nothing.
skipped.quota_estimate: The run would have been too expensive. The channel list is too long.
skipped.running: One is already running. Wait a moment.

finds.title: Finds
finds.lead: Your own list. Whatever the topic radar does not see, you drop in here as a link — it gets read the same way.
finds.addHint: Any form works: watch, youtu.be, Shorts, Live.
finds.empty: Nothing kept yet. Drop in a YouTube link, or press “Interesting” in the topic radar.
finds.emptyFiltered: Nothing on the list with that verdict.
finds.removeConfirm: Take this video off your list? If you just do not want to see it again, set it to “Not interesting” — it stays here and disappears from the radar.
finds.gone: No longer available — the numbers are cleared, your note stays.
finds.keyMissing: Without an API key no video can be read. The server environment needs the line NUXT_INSIGHTS_YOUTUBE_KEY.

error.video_unreadable: No video can be read from that. Use the link from the address bar or from “Share”.
error.video_not_found: YouTube does not know this video — it is deleted or private.
error.video_duplicate: That is already on your list.
error.watchlist_limit: Your list is full. Take something off it.
error.not_configured: That does not work without an API key.

channels.title: Channels
channels.lead: Where the topic radar gets its videos. Each channel stands for one topic — that is the baseline, and a video title may still correct it.
channels.empty: No channel on the list yet.
channels.emptySeed: The radar has been running on eleven verified channels since I4. Take them over once, then maintain the list here.
channels.seedSkipped: The list already exists — the handover happens only once.
channels.addTitle: Check a channel and add it
channels.addHint: Paste a handle, a channel id or a channel address. YouTube can no longer resolve the old /c/ and /user/ forms — open the channel and copy its handle.
channels.previewHint: Title and latest upload have to match what you expect, not just the id. That is how a supposed design studio was caught in September: real id, private account, one video from 2012.
channels.previewKnown: This channel is already on the list.
channels.notePlaceholder: Why is it on the list? One sentence is enough.
channels.removeConfirm: Remove this channel from the list entirely? For a channel that simply stopped delivering, switching it off is the better way — the note stays.
channels.keyMissing: Without an API key nothing can be checked. The server environment needs the line NUXT_INSIGHTS_YOUTUBE_KEY.

error.channel_unreadable: No channel can be read from that. Use the handle (with {'@'}) or the channel id.
error.channel_not_found: YouTube does not know this channel.
error.channel_duplicate: This channel is already on the list.
error.channel_limit: The list is full. Switch a channel off or remove it.
error.not_configured: Without an API key nothing can be checked.
error.rate_limited: Too many checks this hour. Try again shortly.

editor.title: Desk
editor.lead: AI drafts, the desk edits and publishes. Nothing goes public without that signature.
editor.baseLocaleNote: The base version is the edited one. The second language grows out of it.
editor.translated: Translation is on file as a draft
editor.evidenceOk: Quote appears verbatim in the source
editor.evidenceFail: Quote not found in the source
editor.rulesBlocked: One open point — moving to the desk is blocked. | {count} open points — moving to the desk is blocked.
editor.readingMinutes: Reading time {count} min — computed on save.

issue.quoteNotGrounded: Quote does not appear verbatim in the source
issue.sourceMissingLicense: Wikipedia source without a licence link
issue.disparagement: Disparagement or a third-party name in the text: {detail}
issue.scoreWithoutMethodology: Score without a link to the method
issue.brandWithoutEntity: Brand mentioned without its own row: {detail}

reason.competitorName: a brand name without a reference in the brands panel
reason.competitorDomain: a brand website without a reference in the brands panel

editor.saveFirst: Save first, then change the state.
editor.newPostTitleRequired: A title is required — it becomes the address.
editor.createFailed: The post could not be created.
editor.emptyDescription: A new post starts with format, base language and title.
editor.stateBlocked: {count} points open — the state stays as it was.
editor.translateDone: The translation is a draft — not reviewed yet.
editor.draftHint: One brief, one rough text. The draft stays a draft: there is no path from the model straight into review.
editor.draftBriefPlaceholder: What is it about, which claim, which brands, what is already sourced?
editor.draftDone: The draft is in the base version.
editor.sourcesEmptyHint: Every statement needs a source with publisher and date.

evidenceReason.ok: The quote appears verbatim in the source
evidenceReason.not_found: The quote was not found in the source
evidenceReason.fetch_failed: The source could not be reached
evidenceReason.robots_denied: The website does not allow us this fetch (robots.txt)
evidenceReason.tdm_reserved: The website declared a text and data mining reservation

editor.brandsHint: Every brand named needs its own row — otherwise there is no place for a correction to arrive.
editor.brandNameRequired: Without a name there is no brand.
editor.brandHomepageInvalid: That is not a valid address.
editor.factsHintDuel: The duel rows as a JSON list. Each row points at a source via sourceIndex — no evidence, no row.
editor.factsHintRanking: The frozen ranking as a JSON object: issue, as-of date and up to ten places.
editor.factsInvalid: These entries do not match the contract — please check fields and evidence.
editor.prototypeOnly: Prototype — nothing is saved, no model is called.

error.validation: Input incomplete — the review rules on the right point to the spot.
error.aiDisabled: AI is switched off on this instance.
error.aiHourlyLimit: Too many runs this hour — try again shortly.
error.aiDailyLimit: The daily allowance is used up.
error.notDraft: An AI draft only works in the draft state.
error.translationEmpty: There is no second version yet that could have been reviewed.
error.slugTaken: That address is taken — please choose a different title.
error.transitionNotAllowed: That state change is not provided for.
error.storageUnavailable: Storage is not reachable right now.
error.alreadySent: This piece has already gone to the list — there is no second time.
error.notPublic: Publish it first: a draft has no address out there.
error.noPublicAddress: This piece has no page out there — an email would point nowhere.
error.notDeletable: Withdraw it first — a published piece is not deleted directly.

editor.deleteText: “{title}” will be deleted for good. There is no undo.
editor.deleteHint: Sources, facts and the desk note go with it — they live in the same row.
editor.deleteBlocked: Withdraw it first: a published piece is not deleted straight out of the open.

brands.title: Brands
brands.lead: Every brand we write about has a row here — otherwise there is no place a correction could land.
brands.editHint: Marks, history and relations each need a source from the list below.
brands.emptyDescription: A new brand starts with name, website and industry.
brands.slugHint: The address. On a rename the old one moves into the history — links stay alive.
brands.countryHint: Two letters, e.g. DE or US.
brands.checkIdHint: The latest check of this website — that is where the score comes from.
brands.publicationIdHint: If the brand is also a customer: the customer profile wins.
brands.relationsHint: Competitors and related brands. The row itself is not on the list.
brands.marksHint: Symbol, claim, type or colour — one sentence each, one source each.
brands.historyHint: A year, a sentence, a source.
brands.removalReasonHint: Required. We record date and reason — that is what gets asked about later.

error.slugTaken: That address is taken — please pick another.
error.validation: Incomplete input — please check required fields and sources.

corrections.title: Corrections
corrections.lead: People who spot a mistake or want a removal write to us. This is the other half of that.
corrections.emptyDescription: There is no proposal in this view.
corrections.acceptedHint: The change itself is desk work — in the editor or on the brands page.
corrections.declineText: The proposal about “{target}” will be declined. The reason stays with the row.
corrections.declineNoteHint: Required. Without it a decline is just a disappearance.
corrections.declineNotePlaceholder: Why we are not following the proposal.

error.alreadyDecided: This row has already been decided.
